# SeasonRow

A tappable row for one season with its watched count; opens that season's episodes.

`TVTracker.SeasonRow` · Lists

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.SeasonRow label="…" watched={0} total={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.SeasonRow" label="…" watched="{{0}}" total="{{0}}"></x-import>
```
